influences.name: Crystal Lewis
influences.context: As the daughter of a Cleric in the coastal town of Santa Barbara, California, her first fifteen years were filled with nothing but Christian music. But she loved it: "There was so much cool Christian music," she said, noting Crystal Lewis among her favorite artists.

influences.name: The Beach Boys
influences.context: At 15, Perry made a discovery where she "broke in two like the Ten Commandments." She had found secular music: The Beach Boys, No Doubt…and Freddie Mercury.

influences.name: Freddie Mercury
influences.context: At 15, Perry made a discovery where she "broke in two like the Ten Commandments." She had found secular music: The Beach Boys, No Doubt…and Freddie Mercury. Since Perry couldn't listen to these artists at home, she went to lots of sleepovers (sneaking in the CDs) just so she could rock out to the "woman who doesn't give a f—" in the lyrics of "Killer Queen."

influences.name: Alanis Morissette
influences.context: In the motel one night, she turned on VH1 where producer Glen Ballard was talking about Alanis Morissette. Morissette's "Jagged Little Pill" influenced her decision to meet and work with Ballard.

influences.name: Glen Ballard
influences.context: He taught me everything I know (except guitar); he challenged me to write songs every day. He pushed me and kept on pushing me. We wrote 60-70 songs together.

influences.name: Dave Stewart
influences.context: She also worked with Dave Stewart, and when Perry told him she was still afraid to write about certain subjects, he told her she could and should write about anything she feels.

influences.name: Eckhart Tolle
influences.context: I was really inspired by this little six-minute thing by Eckhart Tolle where he speaks about loss

influences.name: Mariah Carey
influences.context: I wanted to make a song that was like what Mariah Carey would have put on her first record

influences.name: Black Box
influences.context: I love the '90s. Black Box, C + C Music Factory, CeCe Peniston, Crystal Waters. I'm so into that vibe right now.

influences.context: I'll probably turn into more of a Joni Mitchell. As I inch towards my 30s, I think my fourth record will be more of an acoustic guitar album.
